backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing course management, user enrollment, and profile functionality with role-based access control using authorization mixins and Map/Set data structures.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping four implemented features (landing page, course listing, enrollment, and visual theme) to their corresponding files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend TypeScript/React files describing components, hooks, routing, and styling for the educational platform.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base styles defining a warm educational color palette using OKLCH color system with amber/orange tones for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the EduHub application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for landing, courses, and my-courses pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider and Layout with Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/CourseCard.tsx: Reusable course card component displaying course details, instructor, enrollment badge, and enroll button with authentication checks and loading states.
frontend/src/components/CourseList.tsx: Course listing page component fetching and displaying available courses in a responsive grid with loading skeletons and empty state handling.
frontend/src/components/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page with hero section featuring gradient backgrounds and generated imagery, feature highlights with icons, and call-to-action buttons using warm educational theme.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with header navigation, authentication controls, and mobile menu. Handles login/logout, displays profile setup dialog for new users, and provides navigation links to courses and my-courses pages.
frontend/src/components/MyCoursesPage.ts: Displays user's enrolled courses with authentication check. Shows login prompt if not authenticated, loading skeletons during fetch, empty state if no courses, or grid of enrolled course cards.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Modal dialog for new users to enter their name and create a profile. Non-dismissible dialog that appears on first login and saves profile via mutation hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on authentication state. Initializes actor with identity when authenticated, handles admin token, and invalidates dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useEnrollment.ts: Mutation hook for enrolling users in courses. Validates authentication, calls backend enroll method, and invalidates enrollment status and user courses queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useEnrollmentStatus.t: Query hook that checks if the current user is enrolled in a specific course. Only enabled when actor is ready and user is authenticated.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication. Manages auth client lifecycle, identity state, login/logout flows, and provides authentication status throughout the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of query and mutation hooks for fetching available courses, getting/saving user profiles. Handles actor availability checks and query invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserCourses.ts: Query hook that fetches all courses enrolled by the current authenticated user. Returns empty array if not authenticated or actor unavailable.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for theming. Defines light and dark mode color schemes using OKLCH color space for consistent design tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component into the DOM.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, typography, container queries, animations, and sidebar styling.
project_state.json: Project metadata for EduHub educational platform tracking implemented features (landing page, course listing, enrollment, visual theme) and pending backend data model requirements.
